subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Which remaining subproblem should be canonical for next work on this issue: reset binding durability, Telegram no-text diagnostics, progress heartbeat, or reset/warm-start UX?
rationale: The source-supported reset invariant is still real, but the issue also asks for new diagnostic and UX surfaces that need maintainer scoping before repair automation can safely start.

options.title: Prioritize reset binding durability
options.body: Make reset persistence atomic or self-healing so a saved session binding cannot point at a missing or headerless transcript.

options.title: Split diagnostics first
options.body: Open narrower follow-ups for Telegram no-text fallback, heartbeat, and usage-finalized metadata before changing reset persistence.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep this as a live-repro tracker until maintainers capture the exact Telegram topic-lane failure on current main.

recommendation.title: Prioritize reset binding durability
recommendation.body: Make reset persistence atomic or self-healing so a saved session binding cannot point at a missing or headerless transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest provenance for the remaining source-supported invariant is the reset transcript path lifecycle history.
